about.text: Calleo provides audio guest books. Guests pick up a telephone, hear the hosts' greeting and leave a voicemail instead of writing in a traditional guest book. It markets this for weddings, birthdays and any celebration.
Calleo is a trading name of B R Ventures Ltd (company number 14783321).

B R Ventures Ltd was incorporated on 5 April 2023 and is active. Its registered office is in Fitzrovia, London (W1T 6EB), and its nature of business is 18201 – Reproduction of sound recording. Its two directors, Bailey Mansfield and Robert Martin-Logue, were both appointed on 5 April 2023.

Calleo was founded by Bailey and Rob. The death of Rob's grandfather, Bob Langley, in 2021 inspired its launch: Rob wished he could hear his grandfather's voice again, which a handwritten guest book entry could not capture.
In a 2023 Love My Dress feature, the founders said Bailey and Rob met at university and launched CALLEO in 2022.
Calleo describes itself as a family-run business. Bailey's parents, Sarah and Phil, handle the admin and prepare each phone once a booking is made.

Booking starts with an availability form; the customer then chooses a phone and package. Full payment is requested through a secure link by debit/credit card or Klarna. Customers receive a welcome pack and record a custom greeting that plays when the handset is picked up.

The phone arrives by courier two days before the event at an address of the customer's choice. It needs no Wi-Fi or landline, and guests can leave voicemails of unlimited length and number. The phone is returned at a post office afterwards.

The phone needs only a standard 13 amp power socket. Calleo recommends placing it at least 5 metres from loud sound sources such as bands, DJs or speakers, and supplies a framed how-to-use guide for guests.
Calleo says it listens to and edits every voicemail, and every customer receives a compiled MP3 file. Keepsake options include a vinyl record or a custom-engraved USB.

After the event, customers receive a first-draft MP3, listen to it in an online gallery, can make changes (adding or removing voicemails), and then approve the personalisation of their USB, vinyl record or video memory book.
Calleo covers weddings in England, Scotland and Wales, and destination weddings. It cannot ship to Northern Ireland.
The company policies page links to Calleo's Cookies Policy, Privacy & Recording Policy, Terms & Conditions of Hire, Public Liability Insurance and PAT Certificates.
The homepage shows a 'The 2024 Wedding Industry Awards – Regional Winner' badge and 'Featured on' badges for Hitched, Same-Sex Wedding Guide and Whimsical Wonderland Weddings.
Calleo's own tagline is 'Calleo. The UK's top rated Audio Guest Book'. This is the business's own claim.

services.name: CORE package
services.description: Published price '£219'. Includes: Dahlia, Lily or Poppy phone; digital PDF instruction sign; courier delivery no later than 2 days before the wedding; pre-paid post office return label; digital audio guest book in 21 days; one opportunity to remove voicemails. Not included: personalised greeting message, physical instruction sign, final presentations such as a USB.

services.name: ESSENTIAL package
services.description: Published price '£338', which matches the '£338 per event' on the Booked Events listing. Includes: Dahlia, Lily, Poppy or Bluebell phone; non-personalised instruction sign; courier delivery no later than 2 days before the wedding; pre-paid post office return label; digital audio guest book in 21 days; one opportunity to remove voicemails; final presentation on an Engraved USB.

services.name: ELEVATED package
services.description: Published price '£437'. Includes: all phones except King, Duchess and Duke; personalised instruction sign; courier delivery no later than 2 days before the wedding; pre-paid post office return label; digital audio guest book in 10 days; one opportunity to remove voicemails or add up to 5 new ones; final presentation as a Vinyl Record or Video Memory Book.

services.name: ELEGANT package
services.description: Published price '£1399'. Includes: any phone type; Lilibet Telephone Box stand; hand-crafted instruction sign; set-up and collection by Calleo staff; digital audio guest book in 5 days; unlimited revisions to remove or add voicemails; final presentation as a Vinyl Record or Video Memory Book.

services.name: Elegant phone upgrade (King, Duchess, Duke)
services.description: The King, Duchess or Duke vintage phones can be added to the packages 'for just an extra £100'.

services.name: Phone collection
services.description: Retro phones (per image alt text): Dahlia (black), Lily (off-white), Poppy (red), Bluebell (light blue), Fern (green) and Pearl (white). Elegant vintage phones: King (antique brass rotary), Duchess (vintage white) and Duke (vintage black).

services.name: Destination wedding hire
services.description: Choice of Dahlia or Lily phone with the Essential package features. The phone is delivered by Royal Mail 2 days before UK departure and must travel in checked luggage only, in a travel bag Calleo provides (about 20cm x 15cm, 2kg). It is returned via the Post Office on an agreed date with a provided label. Published costing: 'Approx cost is £338 for the first weekend of hire + £100 for every subsequent weekend the phone is not in our possession.'

services.name: Final presentation keepsakes
services.description: Engraved USB (up to 10 custom options, from font styles to personal text); Video Book (wedding photos or video combined with the voicemails); Vinyl Record with custom artwork, limited to 30 minutes.

areasServed: Destination weddings abroad (the phone travels with the couple)

gaps: NAME CONFLICT (business resolved). Booked Events post 15223 at slug 'calleo' was re-titled 'Mensah' (modified 17 Feb 2026). On 14 Feb 2026 its featured image was replaced (media 16279) with a photo of a man in a tuxedo holding a microphone, and an Apple Watch face screenshot (media 16278) was also attached. Verified: the featured photo is the same image as the Bark profile avatar of 'Mensah', a wedding MC/host in Surbiton (bark.com/en/gb/b/mensah/bRpPP/; Instagram @Menszh per his Bark bio). The 'Mensah' title and photo therefore belong to an unrelated MC business. All substantive listing fields (description, website, Instagram, email domain, £338, est. 2023, London, unique-services) are Calleo's. Recommendation: publish this slug as Calleo, do not use the Mensah photo or name, and have Jake confirm with the Booked Events admin.
The phone number on the Booked Events listing does not appear on calleo-uk.com, so its owner (Calleo or Mensah) is unknown. Not copied.

Establishment year: the listing says 2023, which matches B R Ventures Ltd's incorporation on 5 Apr 2023. But Love My Dress quotes the founders saying 'We launched CALLEO in 2022', and Our Story mentions a Calleo booking for an August 2022 wedding. Trading probably began in 2022, before incorporation.

The ARCHIVED card image 67c0cf25118b3.jpg is NOT Calleo's work: it shows a GAIL's bakery flower wall (visually identical to 67c0cf2513474.jpg). The post's other 2025 uploads (67c0cf251203f, 67c0cf2512783, 67c0cf2513ba6, 67c0cf251484d, 1-tbp, 2-tbp, 3-tbp) are not Calleo's either. Only 67c0cf251148c.png (the Calleo wordmark) is.

No SVG logo exists: the header uses a raster PNG, the inline SVGs are only Squarespace UI icons, and /logo.svg and /favicon.svg return 404. The best wordmark is a 2500x1184 off-white transparent PNG, which needs a dark background. No dark-on-light wordmark was found. The standalone dial icon is black (2000x2000 Loader.png; 600x600 speech-bubble favicon).
Squarespace's CDN caps image delivery at 2500px wide. Request with 'Accept: image/jpeg' or 'image/png', or the CDN returns WebP.

Rights: the photos are by credited third-party wedding photographers (calleo-uk.com/image-credits). The footer says CALLEO's 'intellectual property rights include images and videos shown on this website and other platforms. Their usage is regularly policed.' Get Calleo's permission before republishing any photo, logo or video.

The only own video on the website is a ~12.6 s HLS background clip with AES-128-encrypted segments; no MP4 exists. Using it needs an HLS player, or better, the original file supplied by Calleo. The YouTube Shorts are vertical; the only landscape Calleo-channel video found is zZRVCFfqhxI. The YouTube channel page sits behind a consent redirect, so the full upload list was not enumerated.

The three Love My Dress YouTube videos about Calleo (AJI5wUtFphk 'CALLEO Audio Wedding Guestbook', HsxcUo9nsmU 'CALLEO Audio Wedding Guest Book - Emotional Voice Recording', I-BTWX0MTU8 'CALLEO Audio guestbook for weddings') were uploaded by the Love My Dress channel, not Calleo. They were removed from videos as third-party uploads. Calleo may have supplied the footage; confirm with Calleo before use.

TikTok oEmbed returned 429 'ratelimit triggered' for all three linked TikTok videos and was not retried, so their titles, thumbnails and public playability are unverified. The account's 478 videos were not enumerated.

The Facebook URL (facebook.com/calleouk) is linked only from third-party features (Smashing the Glass, Boho Weddings), not from Calleo's own site. A plain request returned HTTP 400, so it is unverified.

Event types: Calleo's site names weddings and birthdays ('and any celebration'). The Booked Events post ticks all 13 type_of_event terms, but it is unknown whether the business chose them, so they were not used.

Prices are verbatim from calleo-uk.com/packages and /destination-weddings as fetched on 27 Oct 2026, and may change. The site also offers a short audio sample of real voicemails (static1.squarespace.com/.../Fair+Messages+2.mp3, HEAD 200 audio/mpeg, 605,427 bytes). Publishing it needs permission because it contains guests' voices.
The homepage hero image 'Desktop - 2 (3)-min.png' (phones scattered on green) is a product composite, not an event photo, so it was not included.
